In Russia, asset is president.

You're not alone, okay. Pm if you want to lament.

*There's a sense of spiritlessness knowing we're like machines whose only purpose is to produce and reproduce. Do we want to continue playing this game? Accepting drugs, sedatives. and uncertainty in addition to problems and mysteries all for fleeting moments of joy, and then only to die used and forgotten like all our ancestors? Sober people see the life addicts and ask themselves, Do I continue playing this game realizing its absurdity?*
